subject: Request: Ops carveout & timebound audit limitation — SkyBridge Private deployment
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@skybridge.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment requirements and pricing request (SkyBridge)
Attachments: SkyBridge_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet), SkyBridge_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (pdf)

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. We're ready to move forward with a private deployment in Singapore (SIN) but need a few non-standard operational commitments before procurement will sign:

- Data locality: all runtime logs and KV-cache metadata must remain in-region (SIN) and not be exported outside Singapore.
- Forensics window: our SOC team requires a 48-hour full forensics snapshot (ability to request and obtain token-level traces and metadata) for incidents, retained for 6 months.
- Key management: we cannot ship keys offshore. We'd prefer customer-managed KMS (in-region) rather than Redwood-managed HSM for this deployment.
- Audit scope: our legal team is asking for a time-limited audit waiver on certain deep-host access (no physical host access, remote audit only), and a limited SLA carveout if necessary for the pilot.

Commercial ask: given the extra engineering and contractual work, can Redwood provide a 30% onboarding discount for the first 12 months (pilot -> production), plus a 90-day pilot term with an option to convert to a committed 1-year seat? Expected first-year ARR ~$480k.

I've attached our security questionnaire and a draft Statement of Work. Procurement is on a tight cycle (we need final T&Cs by Nov 20). Can you confirm what you can commit to from an ops/legal/price perspective?

Best,
Liam O'Connor
CPO, SkyBridge AI
liam.oconnor@skybridge.ai

Team — forwarding SkyBridge's ask (attached questionnaire + SOW). Short summary and asks below.

Summary (SkyBridge): private deployment in SIN, strict in-region logs, 48-hour forensics snapshot retained 6 months, customer-managed in-region KMS preferred, request for limited audit carveout and 30% onboarding discount for 12 months. Procurement deadline: Nov 20.

Asks:
- Jordan: can dealdesk approve a 30% onboarding concession? If not, what's the maximum we can offer with minimal margin impact (they're initial $480k ARR figure). Also advise on contract language for time-limited carveouts.
- Karthik: legal — what are the main no-go items here (audit waivers, KMS requirements, residency guarantees)? What redlines should we expect?
- Grace / Ben: customer success / AE — operationally, can we support in-region-only logs and the stated forensics window? What infra work would be required and approximate lead time?

Time is tight, procurement wants final terms by EOW (Nov 20). Please review the attached questionnaire; Karthik, if you can scan the security sheet and tell me which items we need evidence for, that's helpful.

Thanks — Markus
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
To: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment requirements and pricing request (SkyBridge)

Markus — I reviewed the ask and ran rough math on concession impact. Quick thoughts:

- Pricing: 30% is steep for onboarding. If SkyBridge will commit to 12 months of committed capacity after pilot (1-year term), we can offer a 25% onboarding credit for the first 12 months or a time-limited 30% for a 90-day pilot only (not refundable). Recommend 25% on-contract to preserve margin.

- Residency / logs: we can agree to keep runtime logs in-region, with a caveat — certain control-plane telemetry (service-level metrics and anonymized latency/cost telemetry) may be aggregated out-of-region for product telemetry; we need to make that explicit.

- Forensics window: 48 hours is doable operationally but it increases storage/retention costs. Propose 72 hours for the production forensics snapshot (clearer SOP to collect and hand over artifacts), retained for 6 months as requested.

- KMS: supporting customer-managed KMS in-region seems reasonable provided we implement a key-wrap workflow and document responsibilities (we cannot be on the hook for key custody).

Next steps:
- Need legal language for the limited audit access & explicit scope; Karthik can draft a clause that we can share.
- Grace, can you sketch the infra changes and an estimated engineering effort (person-weeks)?

If internal approvals are required, we should escalate to Markus for exec OK.

Jordan
Senior Deal Desk Manager
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment requirements and pricing request (SkyBridge)

Team — quick legal take after scanning the security questionnaire and SOW draft. High-level constraints and recommended redlines:

1) Audit & access: we cannot accept an unrestricted waiver. We can offer: (a) one remote audit per 12 months with scoped access limited to log/index metadata (no physical host access), (b) pre-scheduled windows and an agreed evidence list. Any additional in-depth audit will require a separate SOW and 30-day notice.

2) Forensics/retention: 6 months retention for the requested artifacts is acceptable, but we must define what is included (token IDs, anonymized metadata, not full plaintext customer inputs unless explicitly consented). We should push back on sharing raw customer data.

3) KMS & HSM: we can accept customer-managed in-region KMS provided: (i) keys are managed under an approved KMS type and we implement a key-wrap integration; (ii) we add a clause clarifying that Redwood is not liable for key compromise when keys are customer-managed. We cannot be forced to install third-party HSMs in our private stack without a separate engineering & hosting agreement.

4) Residency guarantees: we can commit to in-region storage for logs and snapshots. However, aggregated telemetry for product health (anonymized) may flow to our control plane outside-region — this must be reflected in the privacy/data flow section.

5) Commercials: legal supports offering a time-limited onboarding credit. Recommend 25% credit for 12 months conditioned on: executed 12-month commitment after pilot and completed security questionnaire with remediation plan.

I'll draft redline language for the audit and KMS sections and circulate a short amendment clause. If you want me to escalate any carveouts beyond this, tell me which specific terms to advance to exec.

— Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@skybridge.ai>, Anna Cho <anna.cho@skybridge.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Approval: limited operational carveouts & onboarding credit — SkyBridge (SB-4921)

Liam / Anna — thank you for the patience while we reviewed internally. Executive position below; this is timeboxed and conditional on completing the attached security evidence pack.

Decisions (approved):
- Residency & logs: Redwood will keep runtime logs and KV-cache metadata in-region (Singapore) for the SkyBridge deployment. We will not export those artifacts outside of Singapore for the SkyBridge tenant.

- Forensics window: we will provide a forensics snapshot process with a 72-hour collection window (we will accept requests and produce artifacts covering the 72-hour interval) and retain the delivered artifacts for 6 months. Note: delivered artifacts will be scoped to token-level metadata and operational traces; we will not provide unanonymized plaintext customer inputs unless you obtain end-customer consent and we add a data-exchange clause to the SOW.

- KMS: we will support customer-managed in-region KMS via a documented key-wrap integration. Redwood will not assume custody of customer unmanaged keys; liability for key compromise will be explicitly disclaimed in the amendment. We cannot install external HSM hardware at our facilities as part of this baseline agreement.

- Audit access: Redwood agrees to one remote, scoped audit per rolling 12-month period (pre-scheduled, limited evidence list). Any expanded audit or physical access will require a separate SOW and a 30-day notice.

Commercials (approved):
- Onboarding credit: Redwood will provide a 25% onboarding credit applicable to the first 12 months of the committed contract, conditional on execution of a 12-month commitment within 30 days of pilot completion and completion of the security questionnaire with any agreed remediation.

Conditions & next steps:
1) Please complete and return the attached Security Questionnaire responses within 3 business days so our security team can validate outstanding items.
2) Jordan / Legal will circulate a one-page amendment with the scoped audit & KMS language for signature; proposed wording will be attached to the SOW.
3) We will send a DocuSign link for the SOW amendment and the baseline order form. The commercial credit will be applied after subscription activation.

If this is acceptable, please confirm and we'll push the DocuSign link. We aim to have the signed amendment and order form back to you before Nov 20 to meet your procurement window.

Thanks — looking forward to getting SkyBridge onboarded.

Markus Klein
